title: a debug leftover: console.log / debug / trace / dir, or debugger
how: in code (not comments or strings) of modules that are not CLI printers

explain.what: A debug left-over is in the code: console.log, console.debug, console.trace, console.dir or debugger.
explain.why: Debug output clutters what the user sees and can leak data. A debugger statement stops the program when dev tools are open.
explain.fix: Delete it. If the output is wanted, use the module's logger or print from a CLI module under engine/bin.

head.engine/lib/a.mjs: export const f = x => { console.log(x); debugger; return x; };
